_note: Devstral 2 (123B, ministral3 arch, FP8-quantized ~123 GB -> MULTI-GPU; card serves at TP=8). Agentic coding model, no reasoning parser. UNLIKE Devstral-Small-2505 this ships BOTH HF (tokenizer.json + chat_template.jinja) and Mistral (tekken.json) formats, so it serves in STANDARD HF mode -- the card's vllm command does NOT pass --tokenizer-mode/-config-format/-load-format mistral. Tool calling uses --tool-call-parser mistral (the Mistral tool format) -- NOT qwen3_coder/glm47; wrong parser silently zeroes the eval (memory: vllm-tool-parser-gotcha). FP8 is auto-detected from the checkpoint's quantization_config (no --quantization flag needed).
_note_serve_cmd: Model card: vllm serve mistralai/Devstral-2-123B-Instruct-2512 --tool-call-parser mistral --enable-auto-tool-choice --tensor-parallel-size 8 (TP is a node knob, stays in the sbatch TENSOR_PARALLEL, not here).
_note_multimodal: Built on a multimodal base -- the FP8 skip-list names model.vision_tower + multi_modal_projector -- but the architecture is Ministral3ForCausalLM and it is served text-only here. If vLLM tries to load a vision tower and it isn't wanted, add --language-model-only via VLLM_EXTRA_ARGS.
_note_context: Served window (max_model_len) capped at 131072 for parity with the other configs; native max_position_embeddings is 262144 (YaRN factor 64 over an original 4096 window). Raise max_model_len toward native on vLLM at KV-pool cost (the reserved KV pool is set by --gpu-memory-utilization; a bigger window just needs the pool to hold >=1 full sequence).
